BarcodeInterval.description: A coordinate barcode interval with its confidence bounds and the 2x2 contingency statistics supporting it.

ci_high.description: Upper bound of the confidence interval for the position.

ci_low.description: Lower bound of the confidence interval for the position.

n11.description: Count in cell (1,1) of the 2x2 contingency table.

n12.description: Count in cell (1,2) of the 2x2 contingency table.

n21.description: Count in cell (2,1) of the 2x2 contingency table.

n22.description: Count in cell (2,2) of the 2x2 contingency table.

p_fisher.description: P-value from Fisher's exact test on the supporting 2x2 contingency table.

position.description: Genomic position of the interval or breakpoint.

CompendiumMatch.description: The degree to which a precomputed sequence result matches an entry in the reference compendium.

PrecomputedResult.description: Precomputed analysis result for a single sequence, including its segmentation, coordinate barcode intervals, and the provenance of the workflow that produced it.

breakpoints.description: List of coordinate barcode intervals representing candidate breakpoints and their statistical support.

compendium_match.description: The degree to which the sequence matches an entry in the reference compendium.

coordinate_barcode.description: String encoding of the sequence's coordinate barcode.

provenance.description: Provenance of the workflow invocation that produced this result.

segments.description: List of segment alignments describing how regions of the sequence align to reference segments.

structural_formula.description: Compact string representation of the sequence's structural composition.

PrecomputedResult.title: PrecomputedResult

PrecomputedResultsDataset.description: Root object containing a collection of precomputed sequence analysis results.

results.description: Collection of precomputed results, one per analyzed sequence.

PrecomputedResultsDataset.title: PrecomputedResultsDataset

SegmentAlignment.description: Alignment of a sequence segment against a reference, with lineage assignment and alignment quality metrics.

coverage.description: Fraction of the reference segment covered by the alignment (0.0-1.0).

end.description: End coordinate of the aligned region (1-based, inclusive).

identity.description: Fraction of aligned positions that are identical to the reference (0.0-1.0).

lineage_id.description: Identifier of the lineage assigned to this segment.

segment_key.description: Identifier of the reference segment this alignment corresponds to.

start.description: Start coordinate of the aligned region (1-based, inclusive).

SegmentAlignment.title: SegmentAlignment

WorkflowProvenance.description: Provenance identifying the workflow and tool invocation that produced a precomputed result.

invocation_id.description: Identifier of the specific workflow invocation that produced the result.

tool_version.description: Version of the underlying tool used within the workflow.

workflow_trs_id.description: Tool Registry Service (TRS) identifier of the workflow.

workflow_version.description: Version of the workflow that was invoked.
